message.content: Sure thing! One of our easiest and most beloved pastry items is our classic butter croissant. We pull them fresh from the oven every morning—golden, paper-thin layers that shatter slightly with each bite, rich and buttery without being heavy. They're simple enough to make consistently, but they always feel special. Perfect on their own, or split and warmed up with a dollop of jam and a spread of cream cheese. Pair it with any of our drip coffee or a latte, and you've got a solid start to the day. Want one bagged up for you?
